calls.title: xom-djvy-pxr
calls.summary: The team discussed several key improvements aimed at enhancing user experience and system performance. A unified global data source selector will replace local selectors to ensure relevant metrics, with safeguards against mismatched selections. Issues related to auto submission and metric mixing were identified, prompting the need for a global filter. The query explorer is nearing completion, with final touches on the group by UI and dashboard flow. Additionally, a dashboard block will dynamically fetch the latest analysis to simplify rendering. The team also addressed ongoing technical challenges, particularly with preview deployments and memory errors, as well as the importance of cross-team coordination for features like lazy loading filters.
calls.keywords: data source selector, metric explorer, query runner, dashboard blocks, filter toggle, big number visualization
